name: せいぎの にんじんシャワー
note: せいぎの にんじんシャワー cast (うさひめ), facing RIGHT (mirror for left). Play 0->1->2, hold 2 until the shots have left, then 3, then return to usahime.png. fxSpawn = sprite-local pixel (frame coords) at the nose tip; mirror x (31-x) when facing left.

frames.name: attack_0
frames.desc: brace: body back 1px and low, front legs planted forward

frames.name: attack_1
frames.desc: pounce: rears up 2px and forward, front paws raised, hind legs stretched back on the ground - FIRE

frames.name: attack_2
frames.desc: hold: stays reared up while the carrots fly
